== Summary ==
Richard Handley at [[DecipherCon 1999]], cropped from Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri26. Photo: Decipher (photographer not credited). See [[Richard Handley]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher's caption names "Star Wars Insider writer Richard Handley" with Evan Lorentz and Super Vol Kim Burns. Handley is the man on the right, listening with papers in hand, as Lorentz (left) and Burns (centre) brief him. Full frame: [[:File:Richard Handley and Evan Lorentz DecipherCon 1999.jpg]].

== Source ==
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20001024231109/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri26.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri26], Decipher (Wayback 24 October 2000). Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020607115434im_/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/large/fri26.jpg fri26.jpg] (Wayback 7 June 2002). Caption: "Evan Lorentz and Super Vol Kim Burns tell Star Wars Insider writer Richard Handley what's happening with the Star Trek CCG World Finals"
